name: Macquarie University Computer Loan Scheme
summary: Free loan of a desktop computer for Macquarie students in real financial hardship.
key: Free loan of Windows All-in-One Desktop computers.
who: Enrolled in an award program and studying onshore
Real and exceptional financial hardship (domestic: means-tested Commonwealth allowance)
WAM of at least 50, or an explanation of progress
No money owed to the University
how: Fill out the online application form with supporting documents
